title: Dave Canales: "Phenomenal" Texans pass rush exactly what we needed to see in joint practice

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Dave Canales: "Phenomenal" Texans pass rush exactly what we needed to see in joint practice
sources.description: The Panthers offense got a chance to test itself against the Texans defense in a joint practice on Wednesday and the results were not good for the NFC South club.
